# Hierag Documentation

Use these docs for architecture notes and retrieval behavior.

## Available Docs

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path
import re


def _docs_root() -> Path:
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if (cwd / "index.qmd").exists():
        return cwd
    if (cwd / "docs" / "index.qmd").exists():
        return cwd / "docs"
    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not resolve docs root")


def _title_from_frontmatter(path: Path) -> str | None:
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".qmd":
        return None

    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None

    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != "---":
        return None

    for line in lines[1:60]:
        if line.strip() == "---":
            break
        match = re.match(r"^title:\s*(.+?)\s*$", line.strip())
        if match:
            return match.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    return None


def _display_name(path: Path, root: Path) -> str:
    title = _title_from_frontmatter(path)
    if title:
        return title

    rel = path.relative_to(root)
    if path.name.lower() == "readme.md":
        return f"{rel.parent.as_posix()}/README"
    return rel.stem.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()


def _is_in_ignored_dir(path: Path) -> bool:
    ignored = {".quarto", "_site", "__pycache__"}
    return any(part in ignored for part in path.parts)


root = _docs_root()
index_path = root / "index.qmd"
extensions = {".qmd", ".md", ".ipynb"}

items = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    if _is_in_ignored_dir(path):
        continue
    if path == index_path:
        continue
    if path.name.startswith("_"):
        continue
    if path.suffix.lower() not in extensions:
        continue

    rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    name = _display_name(path, root)
    items.append((name.lower(), name, rel))

if not items:
    print("- No docs found.")
else:
    for _, name, rel in sorted(items):
        print(f"- [{name}]({rel})")
```
